tools.name: stake_list_games
tools.description: Every Stake Original the tools cover, with its seed checker, simulator and verifier links. Call this first when unsure of a game id.

tools.name: stake_house_edge
tools.description: Return to player, house edge and top payout for Stake Originals, computed from each game's payout table. Without a game it summarises every Original; with one it lists every setting.

tools.name: stake_payout_odds
tools.description: Multipliers and the exact chance of each result for one Stake Original at one setting, such as Mines with 3 mines and 5 gems, Keno medium risk with 5 picks, Plinko 16 rows high risk, or Dice over 50. Includes RTP, win chance and the top payout.

tools.name: stake_crash_odds
tools.description: Chance a Stake Crash or Slide round reaches a cash-out target, the return at that target, average rounds between hits, the chance of a hit within N rounds, and the chance of an instant 1.00x round.

tools.name: stake_verify_bets
tools.description: Replays Stake Originals bets from a revealed server seed, client seed and nonce with Stake's provably fair algorithm and reports each result and multiplier, up to 200 nonces per call. Returns the SHA-256 of the server seed to compare with the hash Stake showed before the seed was revealed. Needs the

tools.name: stake_slot_lookup
tools.description: Finds Stake Engine slots on Stake by name or publisher and returns each mode's published RTP, with the max multiplier and its odds where the site has computed that mode's table.

tools.name: stake_chain_latest
tools.description: The newest round checked on a Stake Crash, Slide or Zoo hash chain and the rounds before it, with each round's multiplier or animals. stake.com and stake.us run separate chains.

tools.name: stake_seed_hunt_odds
tools.description: How often a Stake Original pays a given multiplier or more at a setting, and the chance at least one such payout sits inside a run of N nonces, the maths behind the Seed Hunter.

tools.name: stake_vip_progress
tools.description: Wager left to the next Stake VIP level from a level and progress percentage or a total wagered figure, with the expected cost of that wager on the cheapest games and the sports bet equivalent.

tools.name: stake_hilo_path
tools.description: Payout and odds of a HiLo path: the start card, then each guess and the card that came. The first guess carries the house edge, later guesses pay fair odds, skips deal a new card without multiplying.

tools.name: stake_crash_droughts
tools.description: Rounds since the last 2x, 10x and 100x and the longest run without each, over the newest rounds checked on a Stake Crash or Slide chain. stake.com and stake.us run separate chains.

tools.name: stake_slot_rankings
tools.description: The most played Stake Engine slots on Stake by turnover or bet count over a range, with publisher and average bet, from Stake Engine Insights.

tools.name: stake_bonus_drops
tools.description: The newest bonus drop codes Stake posted to its official Telegram channels for Stake and Stake.us, with value, requirement and post time. Codes expire within minutes.
